summary.text: David Brock Smith is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 1, which his biography says encompasses all of Curry County and parts of Coos and Douglas Counties in southwest Oregon.
He was sworn in as state representative for House District 1 in 2017 and moved to the Senate in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Senator Brock Smith is a third-generation resident of Senate District 1, grew up in Port Orford and graduated from Pacific High School.

After attending Southwestern Oregon Community College and Southern Oregon University, he worked in the culinary industry in Rogue Valley restaurants before returning to Port Orford to take over his family's restaurant and lounge.

His biography lists service as Port Orford City Council president and Chamber of Commerce president and director, former chair and vice chair of the Curry County Board of Commissioners, and a long tenure on the Port Orford-Langlois School Board.
He also served on the board of directors and legislative committee of the Association of Oregon Counties.
